name: China
description: Follow China, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: A new smart coating could improve the cleanup of nuclear wastewater
changes.summary: Scientists in China have developed a smart coating that could make it easier to remove tritium (a radioactive form of hydrogen) from nuclear power plant wastewater.

changes.title: China Purges Top Official Over Corruption and Sex Charges
changes.summary: Ma Xingrui is the third member of the Politburo to be purged since 2022. He once led the Xinjiang region and was previously head of China’s space program.

changes.title: Will Oil Prices Rise as the US-Iran Truce Frays? The Answer Lies With China.
changes.summary: For decades, OPEC influenced the market by how much oil it produced. But China, the largest importer, is demonstrating its remarkable power over prices.

changes.title: Himalayan snowfall has been miscalculated for years, here's how we found a new way to measure it
changes.summary: Mountain snow and meltwater from glaciers in the Himalayas determine how much water is available for drinking, farming and hydropower for millions of people in India, Pakistan, Nepal, China and Afghanistan.

changes.title: Japan Builds Intelligence Agency It Hasn’t Had Since World War II
changes.summary: Facing threats from Russia and China, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is turning to help from Western allies in forming a centralized agency.

changes.title: Graduating without a thesis: meet the people getting ‘practical’ PhDs in China
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 09 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01242-z Nature spoke to three students from China’s first cohort of PhD candidates who are allowed to graduate with products instead of papers.

changes.title: China's 'Green Great Wall' tames desert growth, but scientists warn the fight is not over
changes.summary: For half a century, millions of workers have repeated a task across the deserts in northern China: inserting forearm-length sticks into shifting sand, first in a row, then in an intersecting line, gradually forming a grid. Then saplings are planted at the center of each small square.

changes.title: Japan Is Building a New Intelligence Agency With Help From the West
changes.summary: Facing threats from Russia and China, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is breaking with World War II-era limits on security.
